en: Multiview color postcard showing beaches packed with swimmers and modern high‑rise resort hotels at the Black Sea, titled "MANGALIA NORD • SATURN." The reverse has Romanian handwriting, a Romanian 40 Bani "DENSUS" stamp marked "POSTA ROMANA," and a circular Bucuresti postmark dated 08.09.1976. Publisher and price credits read "EDITURA MERIDIANE," "Foto: A. Iancu," and "Lei 1,50."
